thesis: The page is a sundial laid flat: every section is an hour band split by a diagonal shade line that moves across the viewport as you scroll, and the signature is the advancing edge between sunlit problem and shaded fix.

signature.name: Shade Line
signature.summary: A CSS diagonal conic-gradient splitting each section into sunlit problem zone and shaded fix zone; angle tracks --sw-hour from 5 AM to midnight via scroll. Reused in hero mask sweep, five hour-band story sections, review cards, and footer horizon rule. Hook: data-sw-signature='shade-line'.

palette.family: Adobe Terracotta + Shade Indigo + Sun Cream

motion.intro: Shade line sweeps diagonally across hero from top-left to bottom-right over 900ms, revealing rooftop unit photo beneath. Skippable: line at rest, photo visible.
stories: Shade line angle advances per hour band via --sw-hour ScrollTrigger, 900ms ease-io
Hour numerals count up once in view, 600ms, tabular figures
motion.hover: Hairline underline grows scaleX from left, 200ms, @media (hover:hover) only
